FN-PP7DGGR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 101
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/20/2024
Senate Bill 101 as introduced would codify the existing practice of the Alabama Board of
Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Contractors to no longer offer, and collect fees for,
an apprentice license. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-PP7DGGR-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 101
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/05/2024
Senate Bill 101 as passed the Senate would codify the existing practice of the Alabama Board
of Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Contractors to no longer register, and collect the
associated registration and annual fees for, an apprentice license.

Senate Bill 101
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/24/2024
Senate Bill 101 as reported by the Committee on Boards, Agencies, and Commissions would
codify the existing practice of the Alabama Board of Heating, Air Conditioning, and
Refrigeration Contractors to no longer register, and collect the associated registration and annual
fees for, an apprentice license.
